Eliminate the assassin before he kills Saito.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Find [[Ratsu]] and stop him before he kills [[Saito]].
* See Saito for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

==Walkthrough==
Starting from [[Nahpui Quarter (outpost)|Nahpui Quarter]], head down the bridge and over to the area with [[Qian]] and [[Paomu]]. When you approach them, [[Ratsu]] will appear. Slay him to finish the quest.

==NPCs==
===Foes===
[[Human]]
*{{a}} 20 (26) [[Ratsu]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Saito'''
:''"Yesterday, I rescued several children from these plague-ridden streets and took them to the district run by the Jade Brotherhood where they would be safe from the plague. Unfortunately, one girl's parents claimed that I 'kidnapped' their daughter, and they have hired [[Ratsu]], a well-known Assassin to kill me! If you take care of '''Ratsu''' for me, I will make it worth your while."''
{{offer dialog
|accept = I'll do what I can.
|decline = Sorry, that sounds like a personal problem.
|ask = Please find '''Ratsu''' and stop him before he kills me! 
}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Saito'''
:''"Ah, thank you. I do not know what I would have done without your assistance."''

==Notes==
*Having [[Seek out Brother Tosai]] active in your quest log will not prevent you from completing this quest as [[Ratsu]] will still be [[hostile]].
